additional_page_keys.description: JSON array of other pages affected

capability_key.description: MigrationRequirement key when the work is migration driven rather than page driven

problem.description: What is wrong today, in evidence terms

user_request.description: Nick's own words, preserved verbatim so intent survives the rewrite into a prompt

non_goals.description: Explicit do-not-touch list. Required before a prompt can be approved.

assignee.description: Person or agent the work is assigned to, e.g. Morne, Claude chat, Claude Code

related_finding_ids.description: JSON array of AuditFinding ids this change request resolves

related_thread_ids.description: JSON array of ReviewThread ids that motivated it

prompt_draft_id.description: Current PromptDraft generated for this change request

touches_red_surface.description: True when the work touches processLead, live connectors, Conversion Events, distribution_mode, credentials, live endpoints, billing records, buyer pricing, TrustedForm, or portal scoping. Requires Nick's explicit approval before implementation.

red_surfaces.description: JSON array naming which RED surfaces are involved

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable conditions. A change request cannot reach verified without these.

activity_log.description: JSON array of {at, actor, from, to, note} status transitions
